title: Kafka → Spark Streaming → Delta
description: A low-latency stream into Delta Lake with watermarking, windowed aggregation and idempotent upserts that survive replays.
implementation: Read with `startingOffsets=earliest` in dev only; latest in prod.
Windowed aggregation to 5-minute tumbling windows, appended idempotently.
MERGE aggregates on the window key so replays converge.
repo_structure:
kafka-spark-delta/
  src/stream_raw.py
  src/stream_agg.py
  conf/stream.yml
  tests/test_window.py
  docker-compose.yml
architecture:
Kafka (events) ─▶ Spark SS [watermark 2m, dedupe on event_id]
                    ├─▶ Delta: raw_events (append, bronze)
                    └─▶ Delta: agg_5min  (windowed, MERGE on window key)
